functions.name: getPassword
functions.description: Gets the password for the specified Thunderbird account if Thunderbird already has it available without prompting.

functions.name: getPrettyName
functions.description: Gets the display name of the specified Thunderbird account.

functions.name: getUsername
functions.description: Gets the effective username for the specified Thunderbird account.

functions.name: getHostname
functions.description: Gets the effective hostname for the specified Thunderbird account.
